extract_batch with invalid bytes MIME type

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract_batch;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let inputs_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"[{"bytes":[72,101,108,108,111],"kind":"bytes","mime_type":"application/x-nonexistent"}]"#).unwrap();
    let inputs = serde_json::from_value::<Vec<ExtractInput>>(inputs_json).unwrap();
    let config = Default::default();
    let result = extract_batch(inputs, &config).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
